 11. The physician’s written diet order in the medical chart

a. The registered dietitian should participate in the

does not agree with, appeal to the facility’s ethics

c. If the court has ordered feeding or no feeding and 
there is agreement with the court’s decision, appeal
to the facility’s ethics mechanism is appropriate.

Table 20.7 Nutrition Therapy in Progressive Neurological Diseases
The nutrition diagnoses below are common to the following progressive neurological disorders: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS); Parkinson’s disease (PD); myasthe-
nia gravis (MG); Guillain Barré syndrome (GB); multiple sclerosis (MS); and Alzheimer’s disease (AD).
Nutrition Diagnosis
Nutrition Interventions
Nutrition Monitoring/Evaluation

• Determine energy and protein requirements.
